services.name: Kayak To Car
services.desc: Let us handle the logistics so you can enjoy the paddle. Our 2-3 hour trips are beginner-friendly, with calm, easy-to-navigate water and no experience required. We operate along the upper Milwaukee River near Mequon to Brown Deer, where we’ll get you geared up, walk you through everything, and send you off at your own pace-so you can relax and enjoy the scenic river. If you are looking for a fun thing to do in Milwaukee this summer, try a kayak trip! Simple, scenic, and safe! Promotions: Family 4-Packs, Happy Hour Social Guided Kayaks, Women Who Paddle, and more! Our rotating schedule means we run one section per day from spring through fall, offering our three core sections in Brown Deer,
